definition: to give up to the power of another
description: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

taps.phrase: to aim from behind a barricade
to raise both hands in surrender
